code_floor.source: IMC 2021 §603.10 — 'Ducts shall be supported with approved hangers at intervals not exceeding 10 feet.' https://codes.iccsafe.org/s/IMC2021P1/chapter-6-duct-systems/IMC2021P1-Ch06-Sec603.10

note: D3's default hanger table (duct = IMC 603.10 ceiling, SMACNA 5-1/5-2 'by size class'). The 10 ft code_floor above is the legally-mandated ceiling for ANY duct and is what the engine defaults to. The hardware-by-size bands below are the engine's OWN order-of-magnitude size-class guidance (LAW L10 — no licensed SMACNA Table 5-1/5-2 values ship); they never widen spacing past the 10 ft code floor, only vary the recommended strap gauge / rod diameter. UPC 313.3 and IMC 305.4 do not separately regulate SHEET-METAL duct hangers (those tables are for piping — see pipeHangerSpacing.json); the adopted-code selector here only ever chooses IMC 603.10 today.

hardware_bands.source: plans/03-research/02-mep-linear-estimating-math-and-standards.md A3 — engine-authored size-class bands modeled on typical SMACNA-class practice (mepacademy.com/sheet-metal-duct-hangers/, sbkjduct.com), not the licensed SMACNA Table 5-1/5-2 cells
